Every report must include a reproducible case, so our Data Team can reproduce the issue. Attach the project of a backtest or notebook that shows the issue with the select-project property and the backtest with the select-backtest property, or include a code snippet in the content property. Follow the best practices when you write the report. Before you report an issue, use the /community/data-library/issues/list endpoint to check if an open issue already covers the same ticker and resolution.
